title: GLM Live API Smoke Test as Immediate Default Next Phase
reason: Claim Audit (R2.3-N) confirmed LIVE_API_READY_NOT_EXECUTED: no API key, no human approval, no real outbound request. Cannot be default next phase.
prerequisites: User must set ZHIPUAI_API_KEY env var
One low-risk public query must succeed
notes: live_api code path exists and is functional in framework. Deferred until user provides key + approval, NOT abandoned.

title: Frontend Tool Trial / Stitch MCP as Immediate Next Phase
reason: Playwright sandbox trial completed (R2.3-K/L). But frontend tool trial requires sandbox maturity that Evidence Search Loop should validate first. Stitch MCP requires external API keys not present.
prerequisites: Sandbox lifecycle must be validated with Evidence Search Loop
Stitch MCP requires API key and explicit approval
notes: Playwright loopback_only verified. Frontend tool trial remains a valid direction but is deferred, not abandoned.

title: First Real API / GLM Live Integration Completed Claim
reason: Claim Audit found 5 overstatements implying real API connection that never happened. Claims corrected in R2.3-N reports. This direction should never have been claimed as completed.
notes: The framework is complete and verified. But 'First Real API connected' was a false claim. Corrected to 'External Search Provider Adapter MVP — LIVE_API_READY_NOT_EXECUTED'.

title: Evidence Search Loop as Active Next Phase
reason: Factory needs a search capability that works in loops (initial, error-driven, version-uncertainty, dependency-intro, conflicting-sources), not just one-time search. Evidence Search Loop builds on Search Adapter MVP and integrates with Research Intake, Evidence Pack, and Agent Context.
notes: This is the ONLY active next phase. GLM live API and Frontend Tool Trial are deferred, not abandoned. R2.3-O = Evidence Search Loop. DIR-010 (Single WebSearch Tool) is co-active; Evidence Search Loop feeds into Single WebSearch Tool pipeline.

title: Production Readiness Language in R2.3 Reports
reason: No real cloud, real external API, real MCP integration, or long-running agent exists. 'Production Ready' claims are false. Corrected to 'Local Factory Runtime Ready'.
notes: R2.3-M readiness statement already correctly states NOT production ready. Older reports may still carry this language.

title: Search Provider Live API (General)
reason: All live API search providers (GLM, Tavily, Exa, Brave, etc.) require API keys and explicit human approval. None are active. Evidence Search Loop uses manual/dry_run modes first.
prerequisites: User provides API key for specific provider
notes: Provider framework and comparison matrix are being built in R2.3-O. Actual live API connection deferred until prerequisites met.

title: Independent Search Agent as Active Route
reason: No mainstream practice evidence supports two parallel search truth sources. Converged to Single WebSearch Tool pattern per user directive.
notes: Search Agent concept deprecated. WebSearch Tool is the single external fact source. Evidence Pack remains sole carrier.

title: Dual Search Channel (Search Engine + Search Agent)
reason: Two parallel search truth sources create conflict risk with no mainstream support. Single pipeline: WebSearch Tool -> Quality Gate -> Research Intake -> Evidence Pack.
notes: No evidence supports two separate search channels in first version.

title: Search Agent as Future Default
reason: Future default converges to Single WebSearch Tool pattern. No separate Search Agent roadmap.

title: Single WebSearch Tool / Search Provider Pipeline
reason: Converged architecture per user directive. One external search truth source. Pipeline: WebSearch Tool -> Quality Gate -> Research Intake -> Evidence Pack. Implementer reads Evidence Pack only.
notes: WebSearch Tool is the single external search capability. Provider selection (GLM/Tavily/etc.) determines which API backs it.

title: Search Provider via API or MCP as Active Integration Pattern
reason: WebSearch Tool can be backed by direct API (GLM, Tavily) or MCP server. Both patterns are valid; selection gate picks best for current context.
notes: API-first for now (GLM). MCP pattern deferred until sandbox maturity.
